method: 收录标准：2019 年 1 月至 2026 年 10 月宣布、按含或有付款的总额计不低于 10 亿美元的创新药收购（含按资产收购），不含医疗器械、诊断、工具、CDMO、仿制药 / 生物类似药和私募私有化。金额和日期以宣布时为准；阶段指宣布时核心资产的最高阶段。2024 年后的交易逐条对照了 BioBucks 交易追踪，2019–2023 年对照 PharmaShots / BioSpace 年度榜单，部分交易附单独报道。专利到期年份为公开报道的美国独占期估计，可能因诉讼和延长而变化。
method_en: Scope: innovative-drug acquisitions (including asset purchases) announced January 2019 to October 2026 with a total value, including contingent payments, of at least $1B. Excludes devices, diagnostics, tools, CDMOs, generics/biosimilars and private-equity take-privates. Values and dates are as announced; stage is the lead asset's furthest stage at announcement. Deals from 2024 on were checked against the BioBucks trackers and 2019–2023 against PharmaShots/BioSpace annual lists, with individual reports for some deals. Patent-expiry years are estimates of US exclusivity from public reports and can shift with litigation and extensions.
insights: 笔数在涨，单笔在变小：2019–2022 年每年 15–18 笔，2025 年 33 笔，2026 年前十个月已有 38 笔；但 2024 年以来最大的一笔只有 146 亿美元（J&J 收购 Intra-Cellular），远小于 2019 年的 Celgene（740 亿）和 Allergan（630 亿）。
礼来是最活跃的买家：21 笔里 12 笔发生在 2025 年之后，合计约 350 亿美元，多是 I 期或更早的新机制和平台（体内 CAR-T、疫苗、OX2R、II 型 JAK2）。
2026 年免疫 / 炎症成为笔数最多的领域（10 笔），其中自身免疫的 B 细胞清除方案扎堆：体内 CAR-T（Capstan、Orbital、Orna）和 T 细胞衔接器（Ouro、Candid）。
买家越来越用或有付款对冲早期风险：2025 年以来 71 笔里 45 笔含里程碑或 CVR（63%），2023 年前是 37%；同期 29 笔的核心资产还在 I 期或更早。
一个靶点被一年买空的例子：FGF21 在 2025 年被 GSK、罗氏、诺和诺德三家各买一个（efimosfermin、89bio、Akero）；TL1A 在 2023 年被默沙东和罗氏先后买走。同类第二、第三名往往紧跟着被买。
专利悬崖压力大的公司出手最急：GSK（多替拉韦 2028–29）2025 年以来买了 4 笔，默沙东（Keytruda 2028）买了 3 笔。下面的卡片按这个逻辑把买家和交易候选对上。
insights_en: More deals, smaller cheques: 15–18 a year in 2019–2022, 33 in 2025 and 38 in the first ten months of 2026. Yet the largest deal since 2024 is $14.6B (J&J–Intra-Cellular), far below Celgene ($74B) and Allergan ($63B) in 2019.
Lilly is the most active buyer: 12 of its 21 deals came after 2025, about $35B in total, mostly phase 1 or earlier new mechanisms and platforms (in vivo CAR-T, vaccines, OX2R, type II JAK2).
In 2026 immunology became the busiest area (10 deals), with a cluster of B-cell-depleting approaches for autoimmunity: in vivo CAR-T (Capstan, Orbital, Orna) and T-cell engagers (Ouro, Candid).

Buyers increasingly hedge early risk with contingent payments: 45 of 71 deals since 2025 include milestones or CVRs (63%), against 37% before 2023; 29 of those deals had a lead asset at phase 1 or earlier.

A target can be bought out within a year: in 2025 GSK, Roche and Novo Nordisk each bought an FGF21 asset (efimosfermin, 89bio, Akero); in 2023 Merck and Roche bought the TL1A leaders. The second and third in a class often follow quickly.

Companies facing the steepest patent cliffs move fastest: since 2025 GSK (dolutegravir 2028–29) has done four deals and Merck (Keytruda 2028) three. The cards below pair buyers with deal candidates on that logic.
